## Summary
Patnala Uday Kumar is a Computer Science Engineering graduate from Raghu Institute of Technology specializing in Data Science. His core engineering focus is bridging data-intensive machine learning systems with scalable full-stack web applications. His technical expertise includes Java backend architectures (Spring Boot, JDBC, multi-threading), relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), modern frontend engineering (React.js, Tailwind CSS), and machine learning pipelines (Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy).

## Featured Projects

### 1. Music Mirror
- Description: Real-time facial emotion recognition music recommendation system using React.js and Python API endpoints. Normalizes user facial expressions and dynamically recommends curated music tracks inside an embedded player.
- Tech Stack: React.js, Python, REST APIs, JavaScript
- Highlights:
  - Real-time webcam face-detection pipeline in React.js calling Python POST /recommend endpoint.
  - Integrated embedded YouTube playback and manual mood overrides in a responsive application.
  - LocalStorage-backed user profiles, mood history, and favorites persistence without an external database.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/music-mirror
- Live Demo: https://music-mirror-aos.vercel.app/

### 2. Churn Prediction System
- Description: End-to-end customer churn analysis and real-time prediction system utilizing Machine Learning pipelines and interactive dashboard analytics.
- Tech Stack: Python, Machine Learning, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit
- Highlights:
  - Engineered ML pipeline with Scikit-learn using hyperparameter optimization, standard scaling, and one-hot encoding for customer churn prediction.
  - Developed REST API with payload validation and an interactive Streamlit analytics dashboard.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Churn-Prediction-System

### 3. JavaPath Pro
- Description: Interactive full-stack Java learning platform with real-time code execution, syntax diagnostics, and AI mentorship.
- Tech Stack: React.js, Java, SQL, DBMS, REST APIs
- Highlights:
  - Built interactive Java learning platform with Java 17 execution through execution APIs and AI mentor.
  - Implemented password hashing, JWT authentication, and protected REST APIs.
  - Database persistence for user progress tracking and chat history.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Java-Path
- Live Demo: https://javapath-pro-aos.vercel.app/

### 4. Nebula Cinematic Gallery
- Description: AI-assisted cinematic memory gallery with local image ingestion, metadata generation, timeline sorting, and duplicate detection.
- Tech Stack: React.js, JavaScript, REST APIs
- Highlights:
  - Optimized client-side rendering for heavy indexed image storage.
  - Local object detection and image timeline sorting.
  - API integration connecting to metadata generation services.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Nebula
- Live Demo: https://nebula-nmo.vercel.app

### 5. Spedex Fintech Dashboard
- Description: Comprehensive fintech workspace for tracking spending indexing, transaction velocities, and budgeting aggregates.
- Tech Stack: Java Backend, Spring Boot, React.js, REST APIs
- Highlights:
  - Robust Java Spring Boot backend serving authenticated endpoints.
  - Feature-rich React web dashboard mapping budgets, vendor insights, and reminders.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Spedex
- Live Demo: https://spe-dex.vercel.app

### 6. Job Finder Portal
- Description: Job search aggregator, application tracker, and resume match diagnostic dashboard for junior developers.
- Tech Stack: React.js, JavaScript, REST APIs
- Highlights:
  - Aggregates job listings via custom search endpoints.
  - Matches resume skills against posting requirements using regex comparison.
  - Tracks application status pipelines with progress alerts.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Job-Finder

### 7. SkyFlow Sales Dashboard
- Description: Interactive business analytics sales dashboard visualizing transaction velocities, regional metrics, and revenue targets.
- Tech Stack: React.js, JavaScript, Chart.js
- Highlights:
  - Dynamic charts mapping sales performance by region.
  - Real-time transaction ingestion simulation with metrics summaries.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Sales-Dashboard

### 8. Smart Parking System
- Description: Java-based smart parking space booking and tracking desktop application mapping real-time slot occupancy and reservations.
- Tech Stack: Java, Swing, DBMS, SQL
- Highlights:
  - Interactive Java Swing desktop client displaying slot diagrams.
  - Tracks reservations and real-time occupancy updates in SQL database.
  - Features simulated ticket printouts and check-in/check-out logs.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Smart-Parking-Java

### 9. ETL Data Pipeline
- Description: Automated data pipeline extracting unstructured logs, transforming schemas with Pandas, and loading into an analytics data warehouse.
- Tech Stack: Python, Pandas, SQL, DBMS
- Highlights:
  - Extracts log records, performs schema cleanups and date indexing transformations.
  - Loads cleaned relational tables into DBMS for querying.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Etl-Data-Pipeline

### 10. LRU Cache Java Utility
- Description: Custom thread-safe implementation of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache in Java with generic key-value mappings.
- Tech Stack: Java, Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP
- Highlights:
  - Custom doubly linked list and hash map implementation.
  - Thread-safe synchronization locks for concurrent access.
  - Unit tests validating evictions and cache hit ratios.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Iru-Cache-Java

### 11. Online Bookstore Backend
- Description: Java Spring Boot REST API backend managing user catalog carts, orders, and payment integrations.
- Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, SQL, DBMS, REST APIs
- Highlights:
  - Repository layers with JPA/Hibernate query bindings.
  - Secure user profile registration and token validation.
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Online-Bookstore-Backend

### 12. GitHub Profile Upgrader
- Description: Utility script and dashboard to automatically update developer profiles with dynamic README badges and workflow statistics.
- Tech Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, GitHub Actions, Markdown
- GitHub: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/github-profile-upgrader
